text: Played this for years. Best to over 4000 levels but too hard after that. It became unenjoyable, so started over. Other than that it is a good game and you do get rewards for watching ads. It has been made a lot harder. Once it didn't get harder until the 1000s. Good time waster too. If you are prepared to spend your gold bars, the hard and very hard become easier. Best to collect gold bars to help as the game goes on.

First time playing having avoided it due to becoming bored with these types of games. I can honestly say that thus far I have not found this one boring. However, I can see me becoming incredibly frustrated as the levels get harder. This is when the game requires you part with cash to beat levels designed to be impossible to do without using boosters. Therefore, uninstalling is an unfortunate inevitability, as I won't be gambling on the potential to beat a level, and if succeessful, the next.

Came back after a long hiatus. What has happened to this game? It really has gone to the dogs. The maps screen is so cluttered now, I don't even know what half of it means and I'm sick to death of constantly being asked to make a purchase. So many pop ups up now too; just let us play the effing game!! Used to be great but think it's time to delete for good. Also, you never get the rewards for watching the ads.

just to update the review. everything has been fixed, thank you 🙂. took 1⭐ off due to numerous annoying ads. have been playing for several years, passed over 16000 levels, got over 11000 golden bars, pleased to be in the top 0.1% of players... after app crash today all bars are gone 😭 😭 the game keeps crashing at the daily treat machine. have to rate the game one star to attract attention of the tech support. could you please fix the problem and can I get the golden bars back please.

The game, so far, lacks any competitions, any teams vs. other teams, contests, etc. While other match 3 games have the ability to tap on a power up to activate it in the game, Candy Crush will only allow the power ups to be activated with a minimum of three corresponding colors. Gardenscapes is miles ahead of this game. The power ups are engaged just by tapping on it, they offer contests, and team competitions, and they have another subset of missions.

Sugar Crush is a fun and enjoyable match-3 puzzle game with colorful graphics, simple controls, and many challenging levels that keep players entertained. The gameplay is easy to learn but becomes more difficult as you progress, making it interesting for both new and experienced players. However, some levels can feel repetitive, and waiting for lives or relying on boosters may interrupt the experience. Overall, Sugar Crush is a good casual game for passing the time.

It is kind of fun and usually very easy. I have never bern able to do anything with the store or gold bars. Maybe beacause my phone is too full? Love it. Keeps me interested and I always download when I get a new device. I'm addicted. Wonderfully 'sweet' way to pass time. I've played this for years and still look forward to the intriguing challenges that lay in wait for me in this modern day "Candyland"! Candy Crush is a fun, colorful puzzle game that's easy to pick up but challenging to master. The boosters and events keep things fresh, and while the energy system can be limiting, it adds to the excitement. Overall, it’s a classic mobile game that’s still fun.

It starts out as a really relaxing game, a good time suck and just something to pass time. This game is very sneaky and good at getting you to pay money. It's SO not worth the time, energy, and especially money! I am very good at these games and have played them for a long time. very relaxing, the background sound is cool
